initial.prompt: Create a production sprite sheet on TRUE transparent background, 4 columns x 2 rows, 1536x1024. Image 1 is Aria identity/proportion/style reference, image 2 Leon. Eight full bodies, generous gutters, equal drawing scale within each row, feet on a consistent baseline. Top row Aria PUSHING a cart which is NOT drawn: arms extended forward RIGHT at waist level, palms steady at same position relative to torso, slight forward lean only, elbows softly bent, no clenched fist. Bottom row Leon PULLING a cart which is NOT drawn: body and face right, near arm extended backwards LEFT and slightly down, hand gripping an absent shaft behind hip, free arm natural. Preserve red cape, blue tunic, belt, brown trousers and boots. Preserve Aria elf ears, green eyes, blonde/lavender hair white flower, green gold cape, cream blouse/skirt, brown corset/gloves/boots, band on far thigh. NO cart, handles, ropes, props, floor, shadows, text or background. Only eight separated characters.
